record.label: Late-layer Hermite-8 pathwise control variate
record.summary: Degree 8 passes the Gaussian variance feasibility gate: native aggregate capture is 0.9988974254262966 and the 64,000-path Gaussian sampling term is 1.2879503360777229e-9. The route is not deployable because no audited provider supplies certified true layer-15 Hermite means through degree 8. Using the same samples cancels the control; an independent full-cost split is provably worse than plain Monte Carlo. Receipt SHA-256 6403015b68ec7ede976a7c8a4b2ef936577f7f8e4f0a0b865bab79571c9be9be.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for the current sampled/approximate-moment form. Reopen only with CERTIFIED_L15_HERMITE8_MOMENT_ORACLE: certified true control means and combined bias, exact small-width centering parity, plus integrated Ures/N + Ubias^2 <1e-8 under total cost <2^41.
